symbols.name: starting scratch value
symbols.meaning: The value a scratch wire holds before the procedure runs, which may be any value.
symbols.quote: Let $\alpha$ denote the starting value of a scratch wire, which may be any value.

symbols.name: written value
symbols.meaning: The value added to a scratch wire, computed from data and not from the wire's starting value.
symbols.quote: The computation adds a value $\gamma$ to the wire, where $\gamma$ is computed from data, so the wire holds $\alpha+\gamma$.

relations.quote: The procedure is applied to a [Finite linear network with roles and frames](linear-network-roles.md), whose wires include the auxiliary registers.
